about.title: Rooted in tradition. Alive with celebration.
copy: Preetsiyaan brings the colour, rhythm and warmth of Punjabi celebration into weddings and special events through live entertainment and confident hosting.
From the first dhol beat to the final dance-floor moment, each enquiry begins with your people, your traditions and the atmosphere you want to create.

faq.question: How do we check availability?
faq.answer: Send your event date, location and preferred experiences through the enquiry form. Availability is confirmed personally; the website does not show a live calendar.

faq.question: Can we combine entertainment services?
faq.answer: Use the enquiry form to select multiple interests. Preetsiyaan can then confirm which combinations are available and suitable for your event.

faq.question: What details should we share?
faq.answer: Your date, venue or suburb, event type, approximate guest count and the moments you want entertainment for are the most useful starting points.

faq.question: Which areas do you cover?
faq.answer: Coverage areas are not currently published. Include your event location in the enquiry so travel and availability can be confirmed accurately.

faq.question: Are DJ, lighting and sound available?
faq.answer: DJ, lighting and sound appear in the verified public service profile. Equipment, venue requirements and exact inclusions are confirmed for each event.
